text: We're going to do better and better and better.

text: Nice man, a good man.

text: They knew what was going to—what it was going to take.

context: We're also working to make it easier for Americans to save for retirement. || And under this administration, we will always protect Social Security and Medicare. || They are not protecting it for our seniors.

text: I'm very impressed.

text: Isn't that a shame?
